change.superseded: a partial price-history bundle is acknowledged without rows when a later complete bundle of the same source has rows for exactly the same trade date (date from run_id backfill-/close-YYYY-MM-DD); its rows come from that bundle once
change.closure: a 0-item partial bundle with reason no_data_for_date is acknowledged as an unscheduled market closure only if: the peer venue's (TWSE<->TPEx) bundles of that date are all partial/no_data_for_date with 0 items, neither venue has a complete bundle or rows for the date, the date is a weekday, and the governed tw_trading_holidays calendar covers that year and does not list the date as closed on both venues
change.everything_else: any other partial/paused bundle (other reason, one venue empty, weekend, calendar closed/absent, non price-history source) stops the sweep exactly as before
